respuestas:
Yes, lunch is included for trips departing from Cartagena: it’s rice with chicken or rice with vegetables, plus water during the day and coconut candy between dives. You’re welcome to bring your own food if you prefer; please let us know in advance about any food allergies. If you’re already on the islands, lunch isn’t included, so you’ll need to arrange your own.

We operate every day except December 25 and January 1; trips may also be suspended due to bad weather.

The booking system closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before; after that, you can book online for the next available day.

For the mini-course, refresher, and courses, a medical form is required and is sent after booking.
